university.name: University of Layyah
university.tagline: A Place of Innovation, Growth & Excellence
university.history: Originally established as BZU Bahadur Sub-Campus Layyah in 2009. Upgraded to a full independent university in December 2022. It is the only public university in the Layyah region, serving southern Punjab.
university.spelling_note: Always spell as Layyah (NOT Layyeh, NOT Lahore). Official website: https://ul.edu.pk

vision_mission.vision: The University of Layyah aims to exponentially grow with each passing day, besides ensuring quality education in market-oriented degree programs. It strengthens graduates through distinctive learning in education, social norms, economics, and technology through national and international collaboration.
vision_mission.mission: Support University of Layyah into becoming a center of innovation, high impact applied research, and entrepreneurship.
vision_mission.vc_message_summary: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zubair Abu Bakar welcomes students of all genders and areas to learn, explore and grow with updated, sustainability-oriented knowledge and skills.
vision_mission.vice_chancellor: Prof. Dr. Muhammad Zubair Abu Bakar
values: Inclusivity - serving students of southern Punjab regardless of background

departments.description: The Department of Biosciences at the University of Layyah is a thriving center of biological education and research, dedicated to understanding life at molecular, cellular, organismal, and ecological levels. The Department is committed to nurturing scientific curiosity, critical thinking, and research excellence, empowering students to explore the vast and dynamic world of biological sciences. As biosciences form the foundation of modern healthcare, biotechnology, environmental science, and agricultural innovation, the Department emphasizes a balanced blend of theoretical concepts, laboratory training, and research-based learning . Students engage with cutting-edge scientific techniques and develop the analytical skills required to address real-world biological challenges. Academic Program Offered: BS Biosciences The BS Biosciences program follows the HEC-approved curriculum , offering an in-depth study of genetics, microbiology, biochemistry, molecular biology, ecology, physiology, and biotechnology. departments.name: Department of Clinical Sciences
departments.description: The Department of Clinical Sciences at the University of Layyah plays a pivotal role in the education and training of future veterinary professionals. Focused on the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of animal diseases, the department offers clinical teaching through state-of-the-art veterinary hospitals and diagnostic labs. Areas of specialization include medicine, surgery, theriogenology, and clinical pathology. Faculty members are experienced clinicians and researchers committed to excellence in animal healthcare and clinical research. Through hands-on training, fieldwork, and community outreach programs, the department ensures that students gain practical skills to meet the challenges of modern veterinary practice.

departments.name: Department of Livestock and Poultry Sciences
departments.official_name: Department of Livestock and Poultry Sciences
departments.description: The Department of Livestock and Poultry Sciences at the University of Layyah is dedicated to advancing animal production, health, and management practices through education, research, and innovation. The department focuses on key areas such as animal nutrition, breeding and genetics, farm management, and poultry production. With a commitment to improving livestock productivity and food security, it offers students practical exposure through modern research farms and field-based learning. Our faculty strives to produce skilled professionals capable of addressing the challenges in the livestock and poultry sectors, contributing to rural development and the national economy.

departments.name: Department of Pathobiology
departments.description: Department of Pathobiology The Department of Pathobiology at the University of Layyah stands as a vital academic unit dedicated to understanding the mechanisms of disease in animals, microorganisms, and the environment. The Department plays a central role in advancing knowledge in veterinary sciences, diagnostics, epidemiology, and public health by preparing students to analyze, identify, and manage infectious and non-infectious diseases. With a strong focus on laboratory excellence, scientific inquiry, and applied research , the Department equips students with the academic and practical skills necessary to address emerging challenges in animal health, zoonotic diseases, and modern disease diagnostics. Students learn the foundational and advanced concepts that support careers in veterinary pathology, microbiology, immunology, and public health. departments.name: Department of Plant Production & Biotechnology
departments.description: Department Overview The Department of Plant Production & Biotechnology at the University of Layyah is committed to advancing agricultural innovation through world-class education, research, and technology integration. Drawing inspiration from global leaders in agricultural sciences such as UC Davis and Wageningen University, the department merges the disciplines of Plant Breeding and Genetics, Agronomy, and Biotechnology to address the challenges of climate change, food security, and sustainable crop production. Our programs emphasize a balanced combination of theoretical foundation, applied research, and experiential learning . Through modern laboratories, field stations, and greenhouse facilities, students gain the technical proficiency and research insight necessary to develop climate-resilient, high-yielding, and resource-efficient crop systems. The department follows the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s curriculum standards, ensuring that our academic programs meet both national agricultural priorities and international scientific excellence .

departments.name: Department of Entomology & Food Science
departments.description: Department Overview The Department of Entomology & Food Science at the University of Layyah is committed to advancing education, research, and innovation in the vital areas of insect science, food safety, and sustainable agriculture . This department offers a unique interdisciplinary approach that combines the study of insects, crop protection, and food quality management , preparing students to address the challenges of food security and agricultural sustainability in Pakistan and beyond. Insects play a crucial role in ecosystem balance, pollination, pest management, and food production . At the same time, maintaining food quality and safety is a national priority for health and economic growth. The Department of Entomology & Food Science integrates these two domains  -  understanding insect biology and managing food systems  -  to ensure sustainable agricultural productivity and safe, nutritious food supplies for society. The curriculum is developed in line with the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan’s academic framework , ensuring that students receive a rigorous education rooted in scientific research, laboratory practice, and real-world application. departments.name: Department of Economics & Business Administration
departments.description: Department Overview The Department of Economics and Business Administration at the University of Layyah is a dynamic and progressive academic unit committed to excellence in teaching, research, and professional development . The department’s mission is to cultivate a generation of economists, entrepreneurs, and administrators equipped with the analytical, managerial, and leadership skills required to navigate and succeed in an increasingly globalized world. Our programs are designed to blend economic theory, business principles, and practical applications , ensuring that graduates possess the intellectual foundation and professional competence to contribute effectively to both the public and private sectors . The department fosters critical thinking, ethical decision-making, innovation, and social responsibility , preparing students to become effective leaders, policymakers, and change agents in their respective fields. It serves as the foundation for understanding processes across physics, biology, medicine, and engineering. The study of chemistry enables students to understand and influence the material world, paving the way for advancements in pharmaceuticals, green chemistry, materials science, biotechnology, and sustainable technologies . how_to_apply: Step 1: Visit the official admission portal / eportal at eportal.ul.edu.pk or follow How-to-Apply on ul.edu.pk
Step 2: Select your desired Program Category
Step 3: Register using your Email and CNIC number
Step 4: Fill personal information, academic details, and program preferences
Step 5: Upload scanned copies of required documents
Step 6: Pay the application fee via Bank Challan
Step 7: Submit the application and note your Application ID
Step 8: Check https://ul.edu.pk and public notices for merit lists
Step 9: If selected, complete enrollment by paying the semester fee within the deadline
